hero.title: Give Your Time. Change a Life.
hero.subtitle: Students, professionals, parents and retirees: every skill matters. Join AASRA volunteers helping orphans, flood-hit families and communities across Pakistan.

impact.title: Direct Impact
impact.text: See your effort reach orphans, families and flood survivors first-hand.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.text: Receive a volunteer certificate and reference for your work.

community.title: Community
community.text: Meet like-minded people who share your values of Ihsan and service.

flexible.title: Flexible Time
flexible.text: Help on-site or remotely, weekends or a few hours a month.

apply.title: Apply Online
apply.text: Fill in the short form. It takes about 2 minutes.

call.title: We Get in Touch
call.text: Our team contacts you on WhatsApp or by phone.

start.title: Start Making a Difference
start.text: Join a project that matches your skills and time.

form.title: Tell Us About Yourself
form.subtitle: Fields marked * are required.
form.name: Full Name *
form.sameWhatsapp: I use this number on WhatsApp
form.skillsHint: Select any that apply (optional), or add your own.

success.text: Your volunteer application has been received. Our team will contact you on WhatsApp or by phone soon.
